name: Perigee
description: Golf on tiny worlds: curve shots round moons and race everyone to the cup at once.

badges.name: Slingshot
badges.description: Sink a ball after swinging within 10 m of another world.

badges.name: Aerobrake
badges.description: Skim an atmosphere and land it.

badges.name: Lost In Space
badges.description: Send a ball out of bounds.

badges.name: Photo Finish
badges.description: Sink in the last two seconds of a hole.

badges.name: Under Par
badges.description: Finish a nine-hole round under par.

badges.name: Seven Days
badges.description: Play the daily hole seven days running.

badges.name: Wild Card
badges.description: Win a round with Cards on.

badges.name: Full Course
badges.description: Play a hole in all eight worlds.

controls.action: Look around: the shot follows the camera
Turn and tilt the aim (or the arrows)
Hold to charge, release to shoot

help: Every hole is a small solar system. Look where you want to go (tilt up to loft, down to putt), hold Shoot to charge and let go: the ball curves round the worlds, bounces, rolls and drops into the cup. Everyone shoots at once; lowest strokes wins. Alone, play the bots, the daily hole, practice or the tour.
